evidence.range_scope: Exact frozen source proof/review text for its stated scope; complete internal scientific review is separate from external correctness and priority.

requires_external_validation.scope: Freeze exact conditional proofs and countermodels, retain acquisition-oracle distinctions, and test only a physically calibrated access route against equally informed full-semigroup and established importance-sampling comparators.
